claim_text: V2 evaluated 2,286 origins from 137 WQP monitoring locations unused by V1.
limitation: Internal WQP monitoring locations, not external or unseen-waterbody validation.

claim_text: The 88 V1 holdout locations were reused only as retrospective complementary evidence.
limitation: Outcomes were previously opened in V1.

claim_text: P0 and P1 used the same 8,925 complete-case fit rows for every registered seed.
limitation: Claims are conditional on the eligible development subpopulation.
forbidden_wording: all intended rows entered model loss

claim_text: All five P0 and five P1 slots were trained and calibrated without replacement.
limitation: Seeds are algorithmic slots, not ecological replicates.

limitation: Internal fresh WQP evidence only; no universal model ranking.

forbidden_wording: P1 is universally inferior; external validation

forbidden_wording: P0 and P1 are equivalent; ANFIS is uninterpretable

claim_text: P1 was descriptively favorable to P0 in the legacy-posthoc layer.
limitation: Retrospective evidence cannot overturn the fresh-primary negative result.

claim_text: Results were reported at predeclared 25, 30, 33 and 50 ug/L cutoffs without recalibration.
limitation: Thresholds are project endpoints, not official ecological standards.

claim_text: Interval diagnostics are available by model, cohort and horizon.
denominator: rows and locations published per row

limitation: Cohorts and estimands must remain separate.
